findings.title: Wire the new timeout setting into the shutdown drain
findings.body: Setting [general].shutdown_drain_timeout = 120.5 is accepted (explicitly covered by tests/test_config.py:190) and exposed through configuration serialization at triggarr/web/routes.py:227. However, scheduler.py:70–81 still derives the timeout solely from the environment or a hardcoded 60 seconds, and line 634 uses that constant. With no environment override, a search needing 90 seconds to drain still reaches forced client/database closure after 60 seconds despite the configured allowance. The new configuration path therefore silently fails to control the behavior it exposes.
findings.recommendation: Resolve the drain timeout from the active settings at shutdown, apply the environment override, and use the resolved value throughout the drain. Add an integration test proving a nondefault configured timeout reaches the shutdown timeout.

next_steps: Connect the configuration field to shutdown before shipping.
